title: Integrations
subtitle: Install external coding agents and assistants, then point them at your local Atomic Chat models with one click.
serverSectionDesc: Run an OpenAI-compatible server for your local models, then point the agents below at it.
codingAgentsDesc: Coding assistants that can read, modify, and execute code in your projects.
assistantsDesc: AI assistants that help with everyday tasks.
editorsDesc: Code editors that let you chat and code with your local models.

vscode.open: In VS Code, open the Chat view and run "Chat: Manage Language Models" from the Command Palette (or choose Manage Models in the chat's model picker).
vscode.add: Click "Add Models" → "Custom Endpoint". Name the group "Atomic Chat", enter the server's API key (any text when it has none) and choose the "Chat Completions" API type.
vscode.paste: In the chatLanguageModels.json that opens, replace the new entry with the one Copy settings put on your clipboard, keeping its "apiKey" line, and save.
vscode.pick: Pick the Atomic Chat model in the chat's model picker. Restart VS Code if it does not appear.

jetbrains.open: Open Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys.
jetbrains.provider: Under Third-party AI providers, choose the OpenAI-compatible provider, paste the copied URL and API key, turn on Tool calling and click Test Connection.
jetbrains.assign: Local models are not assigned automatically: under Models Assignment, pick the Atomic Chat model for Core features and Instant helpers, set Context window to the copied value, and click Apply.
jetbrains.agents: JetBrains agents can't use local models; use AI Chat and the in-editor features instead.

xcode.open: Open Xcode → Settings → Intelligence (Xcode 26 or newer).
xcode.add: Under Chat, click "Add a Chat Provider" and choose "Locally Hosted".
xcode.port: Enter the copied port and click Add. Xcode calls /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions on it.
xcode.pick: Pick the Atomic Chat model in the chat. Restart Xcode if it does not appear.

editorWarnings.xcodeApiKey: Xcode's Locally Hosted provider has no API key field, so it can't reach this server while it requires a key. Turn the server's API key off to use Xcode.
editorWarnings.xcodePrefix: The server's API prefix is {{prefix}}, but Xcode always calls /v1. Set the prefix back to /v1 to use Xcode.

serverNotRunningHint: Start the local server above first so {{name}} can reach your models.
customPathHint: Point at the agent's executable if it's installed in a non-standard location that auto-detection misses. This only affects the Installed status here.
noRunningModelToast: No model is running. Load a model in a chat first, then enable {{name}}.

toast.serverStartingDesc: Preparing the Atomic Chat server for {{name}}
toast.installFailedNetworkDesc: The installer couldn't reach the network. If you're behind a region block, set an HTTP/HTTPS proxy in Settings → HTTPS Proxy and try again. Note: SOCKS proxies often don't work for npm/PowerShell-based installers.
toast.configuredDesc: {{name}} now points at your local server — opening a terminal.
toast.configuredDescEditor: {{name}} now points at your local server — opening the editor.
toast.configuredDescOpenclaw: {{name}} now points at your local server. Its Gateway reloads the config on its own — if a chat is still pinned to another model, run /model default in it.
toast.openclawAppReadyDesc: Your config is updated. Open OpenClaw Companion from the system tray or the Start menu to use the Atomic Chat model.
toast.configuredDescCodex: {{name}} now uses your local server through its own profile — opening a terminal. A plain `codex` and the ChatGPT app keep your settings; run `codex --profile atomic-chat` to use the local model yourself.
toast.configuredDescZcode: {{name}} now points at your local server and picks the change up on its own — choose Atomic Chat in its model menu if a chat is still on another model.
toast.zcodeNotInstalledDesc: The Atomic Chat provider is saved. Download ZCode from zcode.z.ai — it will use your local model on first start.
toast.copyFailed: Couldn't copy settings to the clipboard
toast.editorLaunchedDesc: Finish setup inside {{name}} using the copied connection settings.
